correctness.rationale: The four-person strict complete matching problem has exactly three perfect matchings. The assigned verifier enumerates all 6^4=1296 reduced preference profiles and finds 48 unsolvable in two disjoint 24-profile relabeling orbits. Independent audit implemented an entirely separate direct enumeration over all 24^4=331,776 quadruples of complete Mallows four-name rankings, deleting each agent’s own name and directly checking all four candidate blocking pairs per matching. The total unsolvable numerator coefficients at powers 0..24 are [0,0,3,22,82,208,404,642,870,1038,1129,1162,1168,1162,1129,1038,870,642,404,208,82,22,3,0,0], sum 12288. Exact SymPy cancellation reproduces the submitted rational function over Z_4(q)^4; derivative factorization 2q(1−q)H(q)/positive denominator checked algebraically. H is reciprocal degree12 with two positive-root sign variations, H(0)>0,H(1)<0 and exact H(379/1000)>0>H(380/1000), so it has precisely one interior zero and global maximum; endpoint q=1 gives 1/27 and small q onset 3q². This is an exhaustive finite proof of the four-person model, not partial sampling.
